name: MAtCha
definition: A method that employs an atlas-of-charts and depth estimation as input to an MLP, which deforms the atlas and produces high-quality meshes represented with 2D Gaussians.
summary: MAtCha generates high-quality avatars from sparse views using an atlas-of-charts and MLP deformation, distinguishing itself from heuristic-based methods by explicitly warping 2D charts into 3D space.
